<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/forwards/positions/{boxId}/settle"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Pay both sides of a position whose window has been recorded, recording the current epoch in the same transaction when it is due. The network fee comes out of the position; this wallet keeps the rewards, 1 LIT, or 2 LIT when the settlement also records. No body.
